sloka: तत्र प्रविशतश्चापि कल्पान्तघनसन्निभा ।अट्टहासं विमुञ्चन्ती नारी काप्युत्थिता पुरः ।। ५.५८.४७ ।।।।
transliteration: tatra praviśataścāpi kalpāntaghanasannibhā ।aṭṭahāsaṁ vimuñcantī nārī kāpyutthitā puraḥ ।। 5.58.47 ।।।।

translations.english: As I entered the city, a woman like a doomsday cloud rose up before me, yelling and laughing wildly, opposing me.
